title.narrative: Greening the tourism industry in Hurghada, Egypt

description.narrative: The project will implement sustainable technology applications and strategic policy framework to de-risk green investments in the tourism sector, enhance capacities through trainings and raise awareness to safeguard biodiversity and reduce GHG emissions. The project aims to trigger the shift towards sustainable practices in tourism in Hurghada aligned with COVID19 recovery plans targeting to ''build back the tourism sector better''.
